name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Hollow stood there and called that man a thief, a beggar, a destroyer...on the main stage, in front of the world. That's not accountability, that's theater with a lawyer's vocabulary.

name: TASHA RAW
line: The stage is the invoice, Marcus. The receipts get cashed backstage.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Backstage? Twork's still walking around with those charges on his name, and Hollow's back in the title picture. You telling me THAT'S the receipt?

name: TASHA RAW
line: The real invoice gets paid off-camera. Twork's walking, Hollow's paid. We both know who holds the ledger.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Mm.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Nah.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Twork's name's still mud in these streets and Hollow's collecting checks. That ain't justice, that's whoever's holding the mic gets to write the rules.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Mm.

name: TASHA RAW
line: Ask Calicoe if the trauma's real or just a new angle to write checks off.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Tasha's right about the check-writing angle. But Calicoe's whole point in Houston was the handshake that didn't come.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Hm.

name: TASHA RAW
line: So you can't talk crazy to him... but who gets to define what 'crazy' is?

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Who defines it? The same hand that holds the checkbook, Tasha. Calicoe said Brizz was scared, said he was tripping - but Brizz still got paid for NOT showing up. That's respect you can counterfeit.

name: TASHA RAW
line: Conceded. But according to hiphopisreal.com, Calicoe said Brizz was traumatized back in 2019. That's a long time to wait to cash that check.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Okay okay okay. 2019 to now? That's not trauma, that's a RETIREMENT PLAN. Calicoe called Brizz scared in Houston, said he was tripping when Moo announced it. hiphopisreal.com. But Brizz still eating off that no-show.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Hm.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: The handshake's the point, but the handshake's a test. It ain't about fear, it's about who's willing to stand in the fire of the moment and not flinch.

name: TASHA RAW
line: And the fire he won't stand in? It's got a price tag. Respect is the check they're waiting to clear.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: The test ain't the money. It's the man. Calicoe in Houston, P.A.Y.N.E. with Cannon... they ain't asking for a check, they're asking for the man to show up.

name: TASHA RAW
line: Calicoe calls him traumatized, then questions if he'd ever swing a blade. Which man are they asking to show up?

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Hm.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: The man who shows up is the man who respects the game. The man who don't is the man who respects the check.

name: TASHA RAW
line: But according to Calicoe on hiphopisreal.com, Brizz was already 'traumatized' and 'easing back in' in 2019. The check's been waiting to clear for years.
delivery: flat read, looking down at notes

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Calicoe told hiphopisreal.com that Brizz made easy money sitting out, and now he's claiming trauma years back. That's not two truths, that's two invoices for the same no-show.
